The refactor keeps the q register, so name-based matching should map every output and the state register without [match] rules.", "Reading the source by hand: the refactor's toggle chain gives q+1 when up and q-1 when down. Its edge_hit gives q==15 when up and q==0 when down, matching gold's carry and borrow. This is a manual reading, not a proof.", "The design has a synchronous reset only, so no async2sync is needed."], "escalation": null, "notes": "The approved RTL files are referred to by name. Per the task, the platform places them beside the setup, so the setup does not rewrite them. If eqy's path resolution needs them in the same folder as the .eqy file, the setup may need to sit at the top level instead of in equiv/. A failure that names a missing file would point to this. The `engine smtbmc` line names no solver, which leaves smtbmc on its default. If the gate requires a solver word, add an allowed one, such as yices."}

=== FILE: equiv/updown_counter.eqy ===
[options]
splitnets on

[gold]
read_verilog ../updown_counter.v
prep -top updown_counter

[gate]
read_verilog ../updown_counter_refactor.v
prep -top updown_counter

[strategy sby]
use sby
depth 16
engine smtbmc
=== END FILE ===
